authorization_model.group_policy: Any member is authorized only when payload contains official group_jid/chat_id for the same unidade.
authorization_model.explicit_fallback: sol_caixa_autorizados remains fallback/audit path by phone and operation.

rpc_behavior.buscar: Lists up to 10 recent candidate movements for correction/estorno after authorization.
rpc_behavior.corrigir: Updates controlled fields only: forma_pagamento, cartao_modalidade, cartao_parcelas, categoria, descricao, responsavel, valor. Requires open caixa, recent window, motivo and authorization. Audits before/after.
rpc_behavior.estornar: Does not DELETE. Inserts inverse movement with categoria=estorno, blocks repeated estorno via audit, requires open caixa, recent window, motivo and authorization.
rpc_behavior.cofre_balance: Recalculates caixas_diarios.saldo_final_calculado when the corrected/estornado movement is ambiente=cofre.
